description: Deploy a full application on a VM: provisions compute, runs a setup script, and optionally adds CDN and DNS. This is BILLABLE — always dry_run first and report the monthly cost to the user. Pass ssh_key (a public key string) to enable SSH access.

cdn.description: Put the Edge CDN in front of the VM

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

region.description: Deployment region (default london) — list regions via edge_discover

script.description: Startup script id from the Edge library (e.g. "docker", "nodejs") — preferred over setup_script

script_params.description: Parameters for the chosen library script

setup_script.description: Inline bash script to run on first boot (use script instead when a library script exists)

ssh_key.description: SSH public key string (e.g. "ssh-ed25519 AAAA...") to bake into the VM

name: edge_deploy_app
